hints.tr: `ls` komutunun sonuna `> dosya` ekle. Dosyaya giden `ls` her adı ayrı satıra yazar.
hints.en: Add `> file` to the end of the `ls` command. An `ls` going into a file writes each name on its own line.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı (komutları sırayla yaz):

```bash
ls notes > listing.txt
cat listing.txt
```
hints.en:
The full solution (type the commands in order):

```bash
ls notes > listing.txt
cat listing.txt
```

label.en: You printed the file with cat
